column1: # Partition table for a firmware that bmorcelli/Launcher can install.
# The Launcher occupies app0 (test) at 0x10000 (it needs at most 0x160000;
# upstream custom_8Mb.csv uses 0x150000 + coredump at 0x160000). This app
# links into app1 (ota_0) at 0x170000. v1016 max-app: app1 runs to the
# partitions are gone: BOTcorps keeps settings in NVS and data on SD.
# The app image is offset-independent; the Launcher installs firmware.bin
# into its own app slot and ignores this table. Not a flash script.
